notes.title: 1.1.0 Winter update
notes.notes:
🎉 Update now live for Stealth Syndicate! 🎉

Here’s what’s new in this version:

✅ Fixes:
- Resolved an issue where Steam achievements didn’t trigger immediately.
- Add missing translations

🛠️ Improvements:
- Added an option to hide session, (dear streamers, I thought of you! 🎥😉)
- New: A developer’s message box to talk to you !
- Add a timer in Green light (commander) mode
- Add traffic light indicators in Green light modes

🎅 Seasonal Content:
- Festive hats are here to celebrate the season in style. 🌟

Thank you for your feedback and support! 🎮
Feel free to share your thoughts and ideas for future updates.
